paite: Kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum nihna, akha gukna, huai kha ani khat ni in, Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kiang leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kiang ah zawlnei Haggai a kipan TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Thak Ding A TOUPA Thupiak
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen, "Hiai mite'n, eite i kisak a TOUPA' inn lam hun ahi kei," achi uh.
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Yahweh’s house to be built.’”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Haggai a kipan in TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: "Hiai inn kigawpsa a om a, nou a dia na intung dalneite ua na ten hun uh ahi maw?" chi in.
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Na lampite uh ngaihtuah un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

paite: Tampi na tuh ua, tawmchik na la uh; na ne ua, himahleh na vah kei uh; na dawn ua, himahleh na dawnkham zou kei uh; na kisilh ua, himahleh kuamah na lum kei uh; loh mu in iptaw vangsa a koih ding in loh amu hi, chi in.
english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na lampite uh ngaihtuah un.
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

paite: Tang ah hohtou unla, sing va la un, inn lam unla; huai ah ka kipak ding a, hih thupi in ka om ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says Yahweh.

paite: Tampi na lamen ua, ngai un, tawmchik ahong hi hi; inn na hon tut chiang un, ka na mutmang hi. Bangziak in? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Michih noumau inn tuam ah na tai chiat ua, kei inn pen kisegawp a a-om ziak in.
english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

paite: Huaiziak in noute ziak in van in adaitui akhou a, lei in agah akhou hi.
english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

paite: Huchi in gam, tang, buh leh uain, sathau leh lei a pan piangkhia thil peuhmah, mi, ganhon leh khut nasep tengteng tung ah keuna ka samta hi.
english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

paite: Huchi in Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh siampu lianpen Jehozadak tapa Joshua in mikho-suaksunte tengteng toh TOUPA a Pathian uh aw leh TOUPA a Pathian un asawl, zawlnei Haggai thute amang ua; huan mite'n TOUPA alau taktak uhi.
heading: Zerubbabel Leh Joshua In Tempul Lam Pan Nawn
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Yahweh their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thukhah in TOUPA sawltak Haggai in mite kiang ah thu agen a, TOUPA'N, "Na kiang uah ka om, achi," chi in.
english: Then Haggai, Yahweh’s messenger, spoke Yahweh’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kha leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kha leh mikhosuaksunte tengteng kha TOUPA'N atokthou a; akuan ua sepaihte' TOUPA, a Pathian uh inn ah nna asemta uh;
english: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,

paite: huai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni, akha gukna, kumpipa Darias vaihawm kum nihna in.
english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
